decay.unit: normalized; 30 ms–6 s exponential body tau; onset latched

feedback.unit: normalized; squared to 0–0.95 one-sample phase feedback; onset latched

mod_env.unit: normalized coordinated modulation-envelope depth/time; onset latched

drive.unit: normalized nonlinear shaping, neutral at zero; onset latched

gate.unit: boolean rising-edge trigger; note-off does not choke

phase: carrier/modulator reset on onset; feedback contribution reset on onset
remaining: ratio detent versus continuous mapping decision
